author: Nichos Molnar
description: What other day across time and space has the same weather as today? Explore 25 years of weather data across North America.
title: A Day Like This

author: Sofia Molina
description: Remix is an experimental web project that explores remix as a creative method. The piece reinterprets a poem by Mario Benedetti, transforming the literary text into a visual and interactive digital experience. Through the combination of typography and motion, the project translates the emotional tone of the poem into a dynamic visual language.
title: Little Stones At My Window
